description: Reads a dealer's out-the-door quote, pasted as text (up to 8 KB) or given as line items, and checks it line by line: the out-the-door total, the doc fee against the state's cap (and capped service fees such as Ohio's $50 convenience fee), the tax line against the state's rate, finance-office add-ons with typical prices, the trade allowance against written trade-in offers, the trade equity and amount financed, and the walk line. Lines with an email address or phone number are removed before reading and never returned. Nothing is stored.

best_trade_offer.description: The best written trade-in offer still open (CarMax, Carvana...), to compare with the allowance

lines.description: The quote as line items, instead of text

add_ons.description: Dealer add-ons and their prices (paint protection, VIN etching, a service contract)

name.description: What the dealer calls the add-on

dealer.description: The dealership's name (a business, never a person)

rebates.description: Rebates or discounts shown below the price

title_reg.description: Title, registration and other government fees

vehicle_price.description: Selling price before rebates, fees and tax

state.description: Two-letter state code (DC included), like PA

tax_rate.description: Combined sales tax rate as a decimal; leave out to use the state's rate

text.description: The quote as pasted (an email or a buyer's order). Leave out to send lines instead.

trade_allowance.description: The trade-in allowance on the quote, when sending lines (read from text otherwise)

trade_offers.description: Written trade-in offers, to compare the best open one with the allowance

source.description: Who made the offer: CarMax, Carvana, a dealer. Never a person.

walk_line.description: The walk line, out the door

name: check_quote
title: Check a dealer's quote
